"In 1986, Paul Newman and his closest friend, screenwriter Stewart Stern, embarked on an ambitious project. Stewart was to compile an oral history, asking Newman's family and friends and those who worked closely with him to talk about the actor's life. And then Newman would work with Stewart to offer his side of the story. The only stipulation was that anyone who spoke on the record had to be completely honest. That same stipulation applied to Newman himself. The project lasted five years. The result is an extraordinary memoir, culled from thousands of pages of transcripts only recently rediscovered"--Dust jacket flap.
